title: 美联储玛丽·戴利：通胀放缓但AI**强劲，经济韧性超预期
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We have very strong investment growth, exceedingly strong investment growth, and this investment growth is in AI, and it's driven in a lot about physical construction, but also investment
segments.zh: 我们的**增长非常强劲，尤其是在AI领域，涉及大量实体建设以及软件和AI设备**。

segments.en: in software, not software so much, but AI equipment, so all the things that go through that, and that's really computers and technology, IT equipment, and that's very strong, and I don't
segments.zh: 主要是计算机和IT设备，这种强劲势头我看不到任何放缓迹象。

segments.en: see any sense in which that's going to start coming down, consumers, despite the fact that they've been dealing with high inflation above target inflation for five years, they're just staying
segments.zh: 尽管消费者已应对高通胀五年，但他们仍在坚持，并未退出。

segments.en: in the game. They're not the main driver of our growth, the investment side is, but they're not leaving either, and so that's a really good sign for our economy. We continue to have policy
segments.zh: **是增长的主要驱动力，消费者也没有离开，这对经济是个好兆头。

segments.en: in a slightly restricted position, so inflation should come down, and there's all these risks.
segments.zh: 政策仍略偏紧缩，通胀应会下降，但存在各种风险。

segments.en: There's a scenario where we have to fight inflation that turns out to be more persistent.
segments.zh: 一种情景是通胀比预期更持久，我们需要应对。

segments.en: There's also a scenario where the growth just doesn't continue to sustain itself because there's something that pulls out either consumers or the investment slows. On inflation, yes,
segments.zh: 另一种情景是增长无法持续，因为消费者或**放缓。

segments.en: we should look for every, over, look under every stone and take an interest in where we can get better data, more data, and analyze it better, look at history, not only in our own country,
segments.zh: 关于通胀，我们应该仔细审视每一个数据点，改进分析，并参考国内外历史。

segments.en: with other countries, it absolutely, and for employment the same thing, but that doesn't mean that we move the goalposts of our main dates.
segments.zh: 就业也是如此，但这并不意味着我们要改变主要目标。
